=== cypress compose ===
# Docker-Compose Konfiguration für einen separaten Cypress-Container in DDEV
# Die Datei muss unter .ddev/docker-compose.cypress.yaml liegen

services:
  cypress:
    container_name: ddev-${DDEV_SITENAME}-cypress
    image: cypress/included:latest
    profiles:
      - cypress
    # Wir verbinden den Container mit dem DDEV-Netzwerk
    external_links:
      - ddev-${DDEV_SITENAME}-web:web
    environment:
      - CYPRESS_baseUrl=http://web
      # Übergabe der Logins als Umgebungsvariablen
      - CYPRESS_user_r1=r1_user
      - CYPRESS_pass_r1=r1_password
      - CYPRESS_user_r2=r2_user
      - CYPRESS_pass_r2=r2_password
      - CYPRESS_user_r3=r3_user
      - CYPRESS_pass_r3=r3_password
    volumes:
      - ../:/e2e
    working_dir: /e2e
    user: "${DDEV_UID}:${DDEV_GID}"
    # Der Container nutzt den Standard-Entrypoint des Images
    labels:
      com.ddev.site-name: ${DDEV_SITENAME}
      com.ddev.approot: ${DDEV_APPROOT}

observation.command: cd /workspace; ls -la .ddev/commands/*/ 2>/dev/null; find .ddev -name '*.yaml' | xargs grep -ln 'cypress\|setup-docu' 2>/dev/null; echo "=== cypress compose ==="; cat .ddev/docker-compose.cypress.yaml 2>/dev/null; cat .ddev/cypress/* 2>/dev/null
